messages.content: Translate this Maltese legal notice to English: Il-Qorti ordnat li l-avviz jigi ppubblikat fir-Registru Pubbliku.
The Court ordered that the notice be published in the Public Registry.
Translate this Maltese legal notice to English: L-applikant ghandu jipprezenta r-risposta fi zmien ghoxrin jum.
The applicant shall file the reply within twenty days.
Translate this English legal notice to Maltese: The registrar shall notify the parties of the next sitting.
Ir-registratur ghandu jinnotifika lill-partijiet bis-seduta li jmiss.
Translate this Maltese legal notice to English: Il-mandat jibqa' fis-sehh sakemm il-Qorti tordna mod iehor.
The warrant remains in force until the Court orders otherwise.
Translate this English legal notice to Maltese: The decree was delivered in open court on the stated date.
Id-digriet inghata f'qorti miftuha fid-data indikata.
